page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes on the right. Above the column, a centred title. Below the last line, a catchword at right and a signature at left. Text fragments on the left edge belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Ieremias iubet stare super vias, & videre, &
sit via bona, & in ea ambulare. Diuinis
Dum haec agimus, per Dei prouiden-
quam nos tenere cupimus; quos comi-
tes in hoc itinere habemus, quorum fi-
dei ac conuersationis viua atque ex-
via, quam omnes tenent, qui verita-
tem quaerunt. Et ne erroris locus Deum
minus hanc viam, quam solus optime

l.i: Ego sum via, veritas, & vita, nemo venit ad

main_text.l: patrem, nisi per me. Quaerimus primo
exordium huius itineris, quod nos ad

page.notes: Left edge carries fragments of the neighbouring page and a dark blot over "prodit" and "viam", so these two words are marked [?]. The marginal reference at the Ego sum line is printed "Iohan.4 6."; the first digit may be cropped, so it may read 14 (John 14:6). The title "DEDICATORIA." is set as a centred heading. No page number is printed. The page has no running head.
